lines.en: label sanaspring2:
scene barreunited1
We make it to the bar a short while later and I find that business has gotten even better since I slipped into seclusion. Probably because Sara has had less time to think about my penis.
lines.zh: 不一会儿我们到了酒吧，我发现自我缩进壳里以来，生意反而更好了。大概是因为 Sara 没什么时间想我的阴茎了。

lines.en: I say that knowing full well that she was beginning to turn things around even prior to my temporary disappearance. And I’m proud of her for what she’s been able to accomplish within that time.
lines.zh: 我这么说，是明知在我短暂消失之前，她就已经开始扭转局面了。我为她在那段时间里做到的事感到骄傲。

lines.en: But I can’t help but let some air out of the egotistical half of my brain in realizing just how much better off even the adults in Kumon-mi would be without me.
lines.zh: 但当我意识到，就连 Kumon-mi 的大人们没有我也会过得更好时，我脑子那自大的一半还是忍不住泄了气。

lines.en: My psyche comes crashing down to earth and blends in with wine stains on the deep, red carpet covering this aging bar- and it crawls away before I’m able to scoop it back up.
lines.zh: 我的精神摔回地面，混进这家老酒吧深红色地毯上的酒渍里——还没等我把它捧起来，它就爬走了。

lines.en: Here’s hoping someone in need of a little boost takes it and swallows it.
lines.zh: 希望哪个需要点提振的人捡到它，然后吞下去。

lines.en: I’d recommend Sana under normal circumstances, but I’m beginning to think she may have already consumed a piece of me sometime between when my life was okay and now.
lines.zh: 换作平时我会推荐 Sana，但我开始觉得，在我人生还过得去的时候和现在之间的某个时刻，她也许已经吞下了一块我。

lines.en: Either that or she’s been possessed.
lines.zh: 要么就是她被附体了。

lines.en: I just struggle to believe it’s growth at all when she’s done nothing to incite it.
lines.zh: 我只是很难相信这算成长，毕竟她什么都没做去促成它。

lines.en: People don’t get better by simply existing. If anything, that just wears a person down.
lines.zh: 人是不会光靠存在着就变好的。要说的话，那样只会把一个人慢慢磨垮。

lines.en: And unless this aspect of her personality has been clawing at the lid of the casket she sleeps in for as long as I’ve known her, I’m not sure who she is makes much sense to me.
lines.zh: 而除非她性格里的这一面，从认识我起就一直在她睡的那口棺材盖子上抓挠，否则我真不理解她现在这个人。

lines.en: But I guess it doesn’t have to so long as being near her doesn’t make me want to buy myself my own deathbed.
lines.zh: 不过大概也不必理解——只要待在她身边，不会让我想给自己买张临终的床就行。

lines.en: : Hey...I’m back...
lines.zh: : 嘿……我回来了……

lines.en: : Sorry it took so long, but...to make up for it...I brought somebody with me...
lines.zh: : 抱歉花了这么久，不过……为了补偿……我带了个人来……

lines.en: : Is Ayane here again? Good. Get her a uniform from the back room and have her take care of the women in the back. Like...the back table. Don’t let her take any women into the back room. She’s too young.
lines.zh: : Ayane 又来了？好。去后屋给她拿套制服，让她照顾后面那几位女客。是……后面的桌子。别让她带任何女人进后屋。她太小了。

lines.en: : Um...do you maybe want to...look at who I brought with me?...
lines.zh: : 嗯……你要不要……看看我带了谁来？……

lines.en: : Sana, we’re swamped right now. I don’t have time to-
lines.zh: : Sana，我们现在忙得不可开交。我没时间——

lines.en: scene barreunited2
: Ah! Wha- ahh?!?! When?! How?! Why?! Hello?!
lines.zh: : 啊！什——啊啊？！？！什么时候？！怎么？！为什么？！你好？！

lines.en: : Hello.
lines.zh: : 你好。

lines.en: : Do you...still want me to...get a uniform for him? Because I can try, but...I don’t think we have any that will fit...
lines.zh: : 你……还要我去给他拿制服吗？我可以试试，不过……我觉得没有他穿得下的……

lines.en: scene barreunited3
: Forget the uniform! What’s going on?! Where have you been?! Are you okay?!
lines.zh: : 别管制服了！怎么回事？！你跑哪儿去了？！你还好吗？！

lines.en: : I’m procrastinating, I’ve been at home, and no.
lines.zh: : 我在逃避，我一直待在家，还有，不好。

lines.en: scene barreunited4
: Well...is there anything I can do to help? I’ve been worried sick, you know. I don’t exactly have a successful track record when it comes to teachers disappearing on me.
lines.zh: : 那……有什么我能帮忙的吗？我担心死了，你知道的。我对“老师在我面前消失”这件事的成功率可不怎么高。

lines.en: : That...has only happened one time before...
lines.zh: : 那……之前只发生过一次……

lines.en: scene barreunited5
: Yes, but you shouldn’t make jokes because it is also the reason you exist in the first place.
lines.zh: : 是只发生过一次，但你不该拿这个开玩笑，因为它也是你之所以存在的原因。

lines.en: : Hey, Tony...isn’t that the guy from the theme park? The one who showed up with that girl who made you nervous?
lines.spk: Frank: Friend of Takoyaki Son, Son of Takoyaki Man
lines.zh: : 嘿，Tony……那不是主题公园那家伙吗？和那个让你紧张的女孩一起出现的那个？

lines.en: : What? Where do you-
lines.spk: Tony: Takoyaki Son, Son of Takoyaki Man
lines.zh: : 什么？你从哪儿——

lines.en: scene barreunited6
: FUCK, HE’S GOT A DIFFERENT ONE WITH HIM THIS TIME! FUCK YOU, MAN! FUCK YOU!!!!
lines.spk: Tony: Takoyaki Son, Son of Takoyaki Man
lines.zh: : 操，他这次带了另一个来！操你的，混蛋！操你！！！

lines.en: : Dude, calm down. You're doing it again.
lines.spk: Frank: Friend of Tony: Takoyaki Son, Son of Takoyaki Man
lines.zh: : 兄弟，冷静。你又来了。

lines.en: : Hey! This is a violence-free zone!
lines.zh: : 嘿！这里是无暴力区！

lines.en: : Ugh, seriously? I’m getting out of here.
lines.zh: : 呃，认真的？我要走了。

lines.en: : Yeah...looks like we’ll just have to spar elsewhere.
lines.zh: : 是啊……看来我们只能换个地方切磋了。

lines.en: : When did this become such a popular hub for extras?
lines.zh: : 这地方什么时候变成群演聚集地了？

lines.en: : Probably last Christmas. Yuki makes an excellent Manhattan.
lines.zh: : 大概去年圣诞节吧。Yuki 调的曼哈顿一流。

lines.en: : Wonderful. Thanks, Matthew.
lines.zh: : 好极了。谢了，Matthew。

lines.en: scene barreunited7
: When did you meet Matthew?
lines.zh: : 你什么时候认识 Matthew 的？

lines.en: : I can’t really explain it, but I feel like he’s always just kind of been there.
lines.zh: : 我解释不清，但我觉得他好像一直就在那儿。

lines.en: : That’s cool. But you know who hasn’t been there?
lines.zh: : 挺酷的。但你知道谁一直不在吗？

lines.en: : Am I in trouble? Because I wasn’t even planning on coming inside and I’m just going to go home if you’re going to yell at me.
lines.zh: : 我有麻烦了吗？因为我本来就没打算进来，你要是打算吼我，我直接回家就是了。

lines.en: : Your sentence lasted too long and now I feel weird responding to my own question. So I’m just going to say welcome back and not bother lecturing you since I’m sure it couldn’t be helped.
lines.zh: : 你这句话太长了，搞得我回应自己的问题都觉得别扭。那我就只说一句欢迎回来，不啰嗦着教训你了，反正我猜那也是没办法的事。

lines.en: : Sensei’s...still not doing all that well...so if we could maybe...give him a discount tonight...he could drink and...it would help take his mind off of things...
lines.zh: : 老师……状态还是不太好……所以如果今晚能……给他打个折……他就能喝点酒……也许能让他不去想那些事……

lines.en: scene barreunited8
: Why are you trying to get me drunk?
lines.zh: : 你为什么想把我灌醉？

lines.en: : Because it’s the only way my mom ever taught me how to deal with my problems...
lines.zh: : 因为这是我妈唯一教过我的、处理问题的方法……

lines.en: : And it’s an excellent idea, Sana. There is no sadness that can not be battled by the abuse of certain substances!
lines.zh: : 而这是个绝妙的主意，Sana。没有什么悲伤是滥用某些物质对抗不了的！

lines.en: : Just don’t say that around Yuki because addiction is a slippery slope and I don’t want her reverting to old habits when she’s finally doing really well.
lines.zh: : 只是别在 Yuki 面前说这个，因为成瘾是条滑溜溜的下坡路，她好不容易才走上正轨，我不想让她又退回老习惯。

lines.en: scene barreunited9
: I am in no place or state of mind to tell you how to raise anyone, but I will accept a discount and experiment with your methods tonight as nothing else helps anymore.
lines.zh: : 我既没立场、也没心态去教你怎么抚养任何人，但今晚我接受折扣，并且愿意试试你的方法，因为别的办法都没用了。

lines.en: : Why make it a discount? Why not just let you drink anything you want tonight on the house?
lines.zh: : 为什么要打折？今晚干脆让你想喝什么就喝什么、全免单不就行了？

lines.en: : Because that’s a terrible business decision and you have employees to pay.
lines.zh: : 因为那是糟糕的商业决策，而且你还得给员工发工资。

lines.en: scene barreunited10
: Not tonight, I don’t! Everybody out! The bar is closing early!
lines.zh: : 今晚不用！所有人都出去！酒吧提前打烊！

lines.en: : Finally, a level of self-destructiveness and reckless abandon that I can relate to. All of the compassion I’ve been shown today was starting to make me nauseous.
lines.zh: : 终于出现了一种我能感同身受的自毁与放纵。今天承受的所有同情，都快让我恶心了。

lines.en: : Is it...really okay if we close early? The bar is...almost full right now...
lines.zh: : 我们提前打烊……真的可以吗？店里现在……几乎满座啊……

lines.en: : THIS FUCKING GUY RUINS EVERYTHING HE TOUCHES!!!!!
lines.spk: Tony: Takoyaki Son, Son of Takoyaki Man
lines.zh: : 这他妈的家伙毁掉他碰过的每一样东西！！！！！

lines.en: : Do you...know that man, Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 老师……你认识那个人吗？……

lines.en: scene barreunited11
: I don’t think so. But based on that description, he knows me very well.
lines.zh: : 应该不认识。不过按他那个说法，他倒是很认识我。

lines.en: : I repeat, loyal patrons of Sakaki-bar-a! The bar is closing early! Finish your drinks, settle your tabs, then drunkenly wander home! You’re all way too hammered to drive, so you can have your keys back tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 我再重复一遍，Sakaki-bar-a 的忠实顾客们！酒吧提前打烊！把酒喝完，把账结了，然后醉醺醺地晃回家！你们全都醉成这样不能开车，钥匙明天再来拿。

lines.en: : But my house key is attached to my-
lines.zh: : 可我家钥匙也串在上面——

lines.en: : Should’ve thought about that earlier, Taco Man!
lines.zh: : 那你就该早点想到，玉米饼大叔！

lines.en: : Looks like I’m sleeping in the subway again...
lines.zh: : 看来今晚又要睡地铁了……

lines.en: : If...we’re not working...can I go upstairs with Sensei now?...
lines.zh: : 如果……我们不工作了……我现在能和老师上楼吗？……

lines.en: scene barreunited12
: Of course! But don’t think you’ll be alone for long since I’m getting these people out of here as soon as possible.
lines.zh: : 当然！不过别以为你们能单独待很久，我会在最快的时间内把这些人清出去。

lines.en: : You can...take your time if you want...I don’t mind...being alone with him...
lines.zh: : 你……想慢慢来也行……我不介意……和他独处……

lines.en: : That’s what I used to say. Then, the next thing I knew, there was a little Sana growing inside of me.
lines.zh: : 我从前也是这么说的。然后不知不觉，就有个小 Sana 在我肚子里长大了。

lines.en: scene barreunited13

lines.zh: : 咦……为什么啊？……

lines.en: : Because when a man puts his penis in a woman’s vagina-
lines.zh: : 因为当男人把他的阴茎放进女人的阴道里——

lines.en: : What? No!...I meant why would you say that?
lines.zh: : 什么？不是！……我是说你为什么要说这个？

lines.en: : Because if I don’t teach you how it works, I’ll never have a granddaughter to-
lines.zh: : 因为我要是不教你怎么回事，我就永远抱不上外孙女——

lines.en: scene black
: Okay...time to go upstairs, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 好了……老师，我们上楼吧……

lines.en: Sana grabs me by the wrist and drags me toward the stairs — which is a thing I never thought I’d be able to say several cycles ago.
lines.zh: Sana 抓住我的手腕，把我往楼梯那边拖——这话放在几个周期前，我是绝对说不出口的。

lines.en: It feels like just the other day she could barely make eye contact with me. But now, she’s treating me like some kind of...boyfriend that she’s dragging back to her house for the millionth time.
lines.zh: 感觉就像前几天她还几乎不敢和我对视。可现在，她待我像某种……被她第一百万次拖回家的男朋友。

lines.en: I’m welcome here. I’m wanted here. And I feel as if I could come and go without making or breaking someone’s life.
lines.zh: 我在这里是受欢迎的。我在这里是被需要的。而且我觉得自己来去自如，不会成就、也不会毁掉谁的人生。

lines.en: That’s more than I can say about home right now. But that’s exactly why it’s so wrong for me to allow myself a comfortable night in with a family I’m not a part of- despite how badly they may want me to be.
lines.zh: 这已经比我现在的家强多了。但也正因为如此，让自己在一个我并不属于的家庭里舒服地过一夜，才格外错误——不管他们有多希望我属于这里。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
I wonder if they’d take Ami as well...if they’d let the two of us infiltrate their already-fractured home by mistakenly believing we won’t damage it any further.
lines.zh: 我好奇他们会不会也收下 Ami……会不会让我们两个渗入他们本就裂痕累累的家，还误以为我们不会再把它弄得更坏。

lines.en: But just thinking that alone makes me sick to my stomach as I’m treating my niece like a piece of luggage instead of the wonderful girl I know she is.
lines.zh: 但光是这么想就让我反胃，因为我把自己的侄女当成了一件行李，而不是我认识的那个美好的女孩。

lines.en: And right now, I’m more concerned with not having her bump into strangers’ legs on the subway. Or avoiding the stutter-step I’d make if her wheels get locked on a rogue pebble in the middle of the street.
lines.zh: 而眼下我更操心的，是别让她在地铁里撞上陌生人的腿。或者避免她的轮子被街中间一颗乱滚的石子卡住时，我会迈出的那个踉跄。

lines.en: Sara makes her way up the creaky staircase and joins us after ten minutes or so.
lines.zh: Sara 走上嘎吱作响的楼梯，十来分钟后加入了我们。

lines.en: She changes into her pajamas immediately, grabbing a half-empty bottle of wine off the kitchen counter and a few beers for Sana and me.
lines.zh: 她立刻换上睡衣，从厨房台面上抓过半瓶喝剩的葡萄酒，又给 Sana 和我拿了几罐啤酒。

lines.en: scene barreunited14
I shouldn’t drink. Not when I know my head’s already falling off my shoulders. But I also shouldn’t sleep with teenagers or jerk off to the memories of dead girls and that’s never stopped me before.
lines.zh: 我不该喝。明知道自己的脑袋已经要从肩膀上掉下来了，我不该喝。可我也不该和十几岁的女孩睡觉、不该对着死去女孩的回忆打手枪，而这些从来没拦住过我。

lines.en: What’s one more mistake in a life that’s practically made of them? What about a hundred? A thousand?
lines.zh: 在一个几乎由错误构成的人生里，再多一个错误算什么？一百个呢？一千个呢？

lines.en: Retreating toward the glow of normalcy would stand out far more than another bad decision, so I take solace in a different glow — a purple one from a table with built in LEDs.
lines.zh: 退回正常的微光里，反而比再做一个坏决定更扎眼，于是我在另一种微光里寻求解脱——一张带内置 LED 的桌子发出的紫色光。

lines.en: It blends in with the light from the city outside of the apartment....and I find myself existing in a place that feels more like something out of a dream than my actual dreams do.
lines.zh: 它和公寓外城市的灯光融在一起……我发现自己身处的地方，比我真正的梦更像梦境。

lines.en: Sara lit candles.
lines.zh: Sara 点了蜡烛。

lines.en: They’re scented.
lines.zh: 是香薰蜡烛。

lines.en: Sakura again.
lines.zh: 又是樱花味。

lines.en: There is no escape.
lines.zh: 无处可逃。

lines.en: : So, does this mean you’re going to start coming around again? Or should I prepare myself for another two months of complete loneliness?
lines.zh: : 那么，这是不是意味着你又要开始过来走动了？还是说我该做好再独处两个月的准备？

lines.en: : You had Sana, didn’t you? And Yuki. And Maki and Haruka. And more customers than I’ve ever seen in here before. Why is it my existence you need to steer yourself away from loneliness?
lines.zh: : 你不是有 Sana 吗？还有 Yuki。还有 Maki 和 Haruka。还有比我在这儿见过的任何时候都多的客人。为什么偏偏是我的存在，能让你远离孤独？

lines.en: scene barreunited15
: Because you’re the one I like the most.
lines.zh: : 因为你是我最喜欢的那一个。

lines.en: : Hey.
scene barreunited16
: Other than you, sweetie. You know you’ll always be first in my heart.
lines.zh: : 除了你之外，亲爱的。你知道你在我心里永远排第一。

lines.en: : That’s...not how you made it sound just now...
lines.zh: : 你刚才可……不是这么说的……

lines.en: scene barreunited17
: I just mean that I can connect with you in a way that I can’t connect with Sana.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我能和你建立起一种和 Sana 建立不了的连接。

lines.en: : Gross.
lines.zh: : 好恶心。

lines.en: : Not like that. But also like that if you want.
lines.zh: : 不是那种意思。不过你要是想，也可以是那种意思。

lines.en: : Gross times two.
lines.zh: : 恶心乘以二。

lines.en: : Thanks, Sara.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Sara。

lines.en: : I can’t say whether or not I’m going to start “coming around again,” though. I need...some more time to figure out what I want to do with myself.
lines.zh: : 不过我不能说我会不会又开始“过来走动”。我需要……更多时间想清楚自己要怎么办。

lines.en: : You mean...apart from teaching?
lines.zh: : 你是说……除了教书之外？

lines.en: scene barreunited18
: Sensei is...taking a break from teaching for a little while...
lines.zh: : 老师要……暂时休息一段时间不教书了……

lines.en: : What?! Really?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！真的？！

lines.en: : I’m taking a break from everything. I shouldn’t even be here right now. And if it weren’t for me having a soft spot for Sana and a...different kind of spot for Ami, I probably wouldn’t be.
lines.zh: : 我什么都要暂时放下。我现在甚至不该在这儿。要不是我对 Sana 心软、对 Ami 有另一处心软，我大概也不会来。

lines.en: scene barreunited19
: Is...something going on with Ami too?
lines.zh: : Ami 那边……也出了什么事吗？

lines.en: : She’s...completely lost it...
lines.zh: : 她……彻底失控了……

lines.en: : She gave a whole speech today on...how all of us are just...trying to steal Sensei away from her...and it...may have involved a little...um...dismemberment?...
lines.zh: : 她今天当众发表了一通演讲……说我们所有人都在……想办法把老师从她身边偷走……而且可能还涉及了一点……嗯……肢解？……

lines.en: : Your niece got in front of the class and said she was going to dismember the rest of the girls?
lines.zh: : 你侄女站到全班面前说她要肢解其他女孩？

lines.en: : In layman’s terms, yes.
lines.zh: : 用通俗的话说，是的。

lines.en: : Well, I’d probably need some time off after that as well.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那之后我大概也需要放个假。

lines.en: scene barreunited20
: Do you want me to talk to her? She could probably use a mother figure in her life, right?
lines.zh: : 你想让我去跟她谈谈吗？她生命里大概需要一个母亲形象，对吧？

lines.en: : Subtle, Mom...
lines.zh: : 妈，太明显了……

lines.en: : I’m serious, though. A little heart to heart might be good for her. Having just one other member in your family can be super scary.
lines.zh: : 不过我是认真的。一次交心的谈话对她也许有好处。你家里要是多出一个成员，可是非常可怕的。

lines.en: : Like, I’d probably never stop worrying if Sana was out talking to boys since I’d be scared they’d be luring her away from me. So, in a sense, I’m glad most of them went to space.
lines.zh: : 比如说，如果 Sana 出去和男孩子说话，我大概会一直担心，怕他们把她从我身边勾走。所以某种意义���，我还挺高兴他们大多数都上太空了。

lines.en: : And I’m...going to pretend that’s not a little...overprotective...
lines.zh: : 而我要……假装这话不算有点……过度保护……

lines.en: : It’s a good idea, Sara...but I’m not sure if that would help her. Especially not when she’d likely just interpret it as you trying to get closer to me.
lines.zh: : 这是个好主意，Sara……但我不确定那有没有用。尤其是她很可能会把它理解成你想借此接近我。

lines.en: : It’s like...nobody else can even talk to me at this point without setting her off. And I think something is seriously wrong this time.
lines.zh: : 就像……现在连别人跟我说句话都会让她炸毛。而且我觉得这次是真的出了严重的问题。

lines.en: scene barreunited21
: She’s always been clingy. But lately, it’s gotten out of control. And I don’t want it to ruin the relationships she has with everyone else since I...can’t always be there for her.
lines.zh: : 她一直都很黏人。但最近，已经到了失控的地步。我不想让这毁了她和其他人的关系，因为我……没法永远陪在她身边。

lines.en: : But I feel like I should since she’s always there for me.
lines.zh: : 可我觉得我应该陪着她，因为她一直陪着我。

lines.en: : That...does sound kind of tough...
lines.zh: : 那……听起来是挺难的……

lines.en: : I get it, though. But I’m not sure if I have any better advice to give than just maybe trying to get some outside help. Do you think she’d be open to therapy?
lines.zh: : 不过我懂。但我想不出比“也许去寻求外部帮助”更好的建议了。你觉得她愿意接受心理咨询吗？

lines.en: : Not until she’s willing to acknowledge that there’s something wrong. And she’s convinced that everyone else is crazy...not her.
lines.zh: : 在她愿意承认自己有问题之前不会。而且她认定疯的是其他所有人……不是她。

lines.en: scene barreunited22
: Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : Yeah...that’ll happen.
lines.zh: : 是啊……会有那么一天的。

lines.en: A moment of silence goes by.
lines.zh: 一阵沉默过去了。

lines.en: scene black
Then another.
lines.zh: 然后又一阵。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
Then another, as we each take a sip from our drinks.
lines.zh: 然后又一阵，我们各自抿了一口手里的酒。

lines.en: Then another.
lines.zh: 然后又一阵。

lines.en: scene black
Then another.
lines.zh: 然后又一阵。

lines.en: scene barreunited23
Until one of us can’t drink any more.
lines.zh: 直到我们中有一个再也喝不下去了。

lines.en: scene barreunited24
And the other two of us are at the ends of our ropes.
lines.zh: 而另外两个已经到了忍耐的尽头。

lines.en: scene barreunited25
Or at least that’s what I thought.
lines.zh: 至少我以为是那样。

lines.en: scene barreunited24
: You’re making those noises on purpose, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你是故意发出那些声音的，对吧？

lines.en: scene barreunited26
: Huh?...Did you...say something?...
lines.zh: : 咦？……你……说什么了吗？……

lines.en: : Sorry, I...must have dozed off...
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我……大概打了个盹……

lines.en: : So you were just subconsciously opening your eyes to see if I was looking at you?
lines.zh: : 所以你刚才是下意识地睁开眼，看我有没有在看你？

lines.en: scene barreunited27
: Looks like...I was caught...
lines.zh: : 看来……我被抓包了……

lines.en: : Looks like it.
lines.zh: : 看来是的。

lines.en: : You know...
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……

lines.en: : She’s not going to wake up...
lines.zh: : 她不会醒的……

lines.en: scene barreunited28
: And you’ve been drinking...so it wouldn’t be...that unusual if...you were to...maybe...make a bad decision...
lines.zh: : 而且你喝了酒……所以如果……你……也许……做了个坏决定，也不会……太不寻常……

lines.en: : Right?...
scene barreunited29
: Or maybe...you want me to be the one who makes a bad decision?...
lines.zh: : 或者也许……你想让做坏决定的那个人是我？……

lines.en: : Is that what you want, Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 那就是你想要的吗，老师？……

lines.en: : Sana...
lines.zh: : Sana……

lines.en: : What's wrong?...
lines.zh: : 怎么了？……

lines.en: : Don't you want me to make you...feel good?...
lines.zh: : 你不想让我……让你舒服一下吗？……

lines.en: : Is this just what you’re going to be like now?
lines.zh: : 这就是你现在的样子了吗？

lines.en: : What do you mean?...
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？……

lines.en: : What do you think I mean?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我什么意思？

lines.en: : Maybe I’ve always been like this and you just didn’t want to believe it?...
lines.zh: : 也许我一直都是这样，只是你不愿意相信罢了？……

lines.en: : Maybe. Or maybe something’s changed.
lines.zh: : 也许是吧。也可能有什么变了。

lines.en: : Does it really matter either way? You want me...don’t you?...
lines.zh: : 不管哪种，真有区别吗？你想要我……不是吗？……

lines.en: : You think I’m cute...I think you’re cute...
lines.zh: : 你觉得我可爱……我觉得你可爱……

lines.en: : And your fingers are much bigger than mine...you can reach deeper than I can...
lines.zh: : 而且你的手指比我的大得多……你能比我伸得更深……

lines.en: : You want me to suck it?...
lines.zh: : 你想让我舔它吗？……

lines.en: : You’re probably pent up after all that time away, aren’t you?...
lines.zh: : 消失了那么久，你大概憋坏了吧？……

lines.en: : What happened at the Halloween party?
lines.zh: : 万圣节派对上发生了什么？

lines.en: scene barreunited30
: You...
: You don’t...
: You don’t remember?...
lines.zh: : 你不记得了？……

lines.en: : I know...something happened. I just don’t remember what.
lines.zh: : 我知道……发生了一些事。我只是不记得是什么。

lines.en: : I was kind of...blacked out for a lot of that night.
lines.zh: : 那天晚上我有大半时间……是断片的。

lines.en: : Well...you were talking to someone who wasn’t actually there, so...I guess that makes sense...
lines.zh: : 嗯……你当时在跟一个其实并不在场的人说话，所以……我想那说得通……

lines.en: : You really...don’t remember any of the details, though?...
lines.zh: : 不过你真的……一点细节都不记得吗？……

lines.en: : Not really...no...
lines.zh: : 基本上……不记得……

lines.en: : Then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: scene barreunited31
: Maybe I should try to remind you?...
lines.zh: : 也许我该试着帮你回想起来？……
